title: release-provenance --post cannot tell a never-published version from one published without an attestation
description:
Found by the LCLI-625 reviewer (2026-09-28); recorded by the LCLI-625 implementer from the reviewer's report, with both cited sites re-read at the LCLI-625 branch head.

MECHANISM: readProvenance in scripts/release-provenance.mjs treats an HTTP 404 from npm's attestation endpoint as 'absent' ('registry has no attestations for this version'). npm answers the same way for a version that was never published at all, so --post cannot tell 'published, no attestation' from 'not published'.

WHERE IT BITES: release.yml's publish job publishes the six platform packages first and the X-rc.N launcher last (publish_or_skip "$root" after the platform loop). If that job dies before the launcher, provenance-post still runs (its if: is !cancelled() && needs.publish.result != 'skipped'). It then reports the rc launcher as unattested, with the LCLI-482 manual-publish explanation, which is wrong: the launcher was never published. And if any platform package of that release IS attested, the propagation window waits the full PROVENANCE_WAIT_SECONDS (180s) on a version that does not exist.

FIX: before reading attestations, check that the version exists on the registry (a packument or version read that distinguishes npm's not-found from an outage), and report 'not published' as its own outcome. It should not be folded into absent, should not get a propagation wait, and should carry text naming the partial publish rather than LCLI-482.

acceptanceCriteria.text: --post reports a package@version that is not on the registry as a distinct not-published outcome, never as absent, proven by a stub test in which the launcher X-rc.N was never published
A not-published package gets no propagation wait even when another package of the release is attested, proven by a bounded-time test
The not-published warning names a partial publish, not the LCLI-482 manual-publish cause, and a registry outage while checking existence is inconclusive rather than not-published
bun test and bun run lore check exit 0; a reviewer pass covers the scripts/ change

plan: 1. Measure the real registry (npm 12.1.0, node 24.20.0, 2026-09-28): the attestation endpoint answers an identical 404 {"error":"Not found"} for published-unattested @opum-ai/lore@0.11.0 and never-published @opum-ai/lore@9.9.9-rc.1; the abbreviated packument (200, versions map) tells them apart.

2. Add a packument-based existence read to scripts/release-provenance.mjs, used by --post pass 1 before the attestation read. Packument 200 without the version: NOT_PUBLISHED, a new outcome that is never absent and never waited on. Packument 200 with it: proceed as today. Any other answer (thrown fetch, 5xx, 404 on the package, no versions map): unknown, and the attestation is still read so a dangling pin is not skipped; unknown plus no attestation is INCONCLUSIVE, never not-published.
3. Report NOT_PUBLISHED with its own ::warning:: naming a partial publish (and the LCLI-460 read-API lag as the one other explanation), never LCLI-482; add it to the step-summary verdict.

4. Stub tests in test/release-provenance.test.ts: per-package packuments in the stub; a never-published launcher X-rc.N is not-published; a bounded-time test with an attested platform and an unpublished launcher; a packument outage and a package-level 404 are inconclusive; the existing absent and lag tests stay green.
5. Mutation control: remove the existence check, predict which tests go red, run, compare.

6. Gates: bun test, bun run typecheck, bun run lint, bun run lore check (from source); PR to dev; tracker note with the gates and PR number. The reviewer pass on the scripts/ change (AC4) belongs to the dispatcher.
implementationNotes: MUTATION PREDICTION, recorded before running (2026-09-28). Mutant M1: checkPublishedOne reduced to `return checkOne(name, version, expectedRepo)`, i.e. the existence read removed from --post pass 1 (the pre-fix behaviour). Read from the per-test "Mutant:" comments in test/release-provenance.test.ts, predicted RED, 6 of 58: (1) AC1 never-published launcher is not-published; (2) AC2 no propagation wait bounded-time (outcome absent + 30s window, so the 3s bound/5s test timeout); (3) positive control, published unattested package still gets its window (launcher window line appears, elapsed ~4s); (4) AC3 version-document outage is inconclusive (reads absent); (5) AC3 versioned 404 not believed until package-level read (reads absent); (6) whole-package 404 is inconclusive (reads absent). Predicted GREEN: "an existence outage does not skip the dangling check" (the mutant never reads existence, so it still resolves the attestation and goes red on the destroyed commit) and all 51 pre-existing tests, since the mutant is the pre-fix code path.

MEASURED (2026-09-28T15:06Z, npm 12.1.0, node v24.20.0, read-only curl against registry.npmjs.org): the attestation endpoint answers HTTP 404 body {"error":"Not found"} for BOTH @opum-ai/lore@0.11.0 (published, unattested) and @opum-ai/lore@9.9.9-rc.1 (never published), so the defect reproduces against production. Version document /@opum-ai%2flore/0.11.0 -> 200; /@opum-ai%2flore/9.9.9-rc.1 -> 404 body "version not found: 9.9.9-rc.1" (a bare JSON string); a nonexistent package -> 404 "Not Found" on the version doc and 404 {"error":...} on the abbreviated packument. Abbreviated packument (accept application/vnd.npm.install-v1+json) -> 200 with keys dist-tags,modified,name,versions; its versions map lists no rc strings for @opum-ai/lore as of this read. npm 12 `npm view <pkg>@<missing> version --json` exits 1 and prints {"error":{"code":"E404","summary":"No match found for version ..."}}; for a present version it prints a one-element ARRAY ["0.11.0"], not a bare string -- recorded, not used (the script uses fetch).

DESIGN (implemented): --post pass 1 now calls checkPublishedOne -> versionOnRegistry before readProvenance. A versioned 404 is believed only when corroborated by a package-level read (packument 200 whose versions map lacks the version), the same shape as the GitHub side (422 corroborated by the repo resolving). Outcomes: version doc 200 -> published; 404 + packument without it -> NOT_PUBLISHED ("not-published", own ::warning:: naming a partial publish and the LCLI-460 read-API lag as the only other explanation, never LCLI-482; own step-summary verdict); 404 + packument listing it -> published; anything else -> unknown. Unknown is never not-published: the attestation is still read (a readable attestation proves the version exists, so a dangling pin is still caught during a packument/version-doc outage), and only unknown + attestation 404 becomes INCONCLUSIVE. Pass 2 (propagation) still iterates ABSENT only, so NOT_PUBLISHED and INCONCLUSIVE get no window. --pre is unchanged: every version it checks is taken from the packument it already read. Live read-only run against production: `--post --launcher-rc 1 --version 0.11.0 --package @opum-ai/lore --package @opum-ai/lore-darwin-arm64 --wait-seconds 30` -> not-published @opum-ai/lore@0.11.0-rc.1 (26 versions listed), absent @opum-ai/lore-darwin-arm64@0.11.0, exit 0, no window spent.

MUTATION RESULTS. M1 (existence read removed from --post pass 1; prediction recorded in the earlier note before the run): RED exactly the 6 predicted of 58 -- AC1 not-published; AC2 bounded-time (red via bun 5s test timeout at 5000.31ms, so the 3s bound assertion itself did not evaluate; the mutant was spending the 30s window); positive control (4052ms, launcher window line present); version-doc outage inconclusive; versioned-404-not-believed; whole-package 404. GREEN as predicted: "existence outage does not skip the dangling check" and all 51 pre-existing tests. M3 (versioned 404 trusted without the packument corroboration): RED exactly 2 of 58 -- versioned-404-not-believed and whole-package-404, 56 green. M3 prediction was stated in the session transcript before the run but not written here first. Script restored byte-identical to the fixed copy (cmp) after each mutant.

GATES (branch fix/LCLI-628-provenance-not-published, lore 0.11.0 from source, quest 0.11.0, bun 1.3.14, node v24.20.0): bun test full suite exit 0 -- 4316 pass, 1 skip, 0 fail, 4317 tests across 120 files (the first full run had 1 env failure, test/ladybug-version-qualification.test.ts ENOENT on node_modules/@ladybugdb/core: the fresh worktree had no node_modules and bun resolved imports from the parent checkout; bun install --frozen-lockfile fixed it; unrelated to this diff). test/release-provenance.test.ts 58 pass (51 existing + 7 new). bun run typecheck exit 0. bun run lint exit 0 (4 warnings + 1 info, all in files this diff does not touch). bun run lore check exit 0: 82 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 9 out-of-bundle links skipped. A comment-only edit to readProvenance followed the full-suite run; lint, typecheck and the 58 provenance tests were re-run green on it. AC4 reviewer pass on the scripts/ change is still owed (dispatcher).
